plan.objective: Calibrate the training reference face scale to the range inference actually supplies.
plan.hypothesis: The model renders a face at the scale its training references had. Cosmic crops are ~42%; validation references span 6.2-50.4%. Every undersized face belongs to the three identities below 8% (jensen/jisoo/keanu). CL2 proved scale control fixes it but collapsed id_sim by locking scale AND position, letting the branch learn an in-place copy.
plan.single_scientific_change: reference composited into a 1024 canvas with face fraction sampled from [0.06, 0.30] and position jittered by up to 0.15 of the canvas
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, masked_loss_step=1, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240 tensors / 219,217,920 params, reference mirroring off, pose-first captions capped at 50
plan.primary_metric: FACE SCALE: count of images whose detected face is below 0.8 of the fixed mask box, via tools/datasets/measure_face_body_alignment.py at MATCHED steps. E13=0, CL2=1, CL4=6, CL0=10, CL3=12. id_sim is explicitly secondary.

decision_gates.step_4000: undersized count below CL4's 6; id_sim within 0.02 of CL4
decision_gates.step_8000: jensen/jisoo/keanu undersized counts trending to zero

preflight.note: reference face fraction now 15.1% (was ~42%), inside the 6-30% inference range

plan.allocation_exception: None required. Project usage after this submission is 6 A100, within the normal six-A100 ceiling in AGENTS.md. The earlier 10/11-GPU one-offs have expired.
